  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "Dress the {{ing_01|hare}} as for Kid à la Tarpeius (℞ No. 363)."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "Before cooking, decorate it nicely."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "Season with {{ing_02|pepper}}, {{ing_03|rue}}, {{ing_04|satury}}, {{ing_05|onion}}, {{ing_06|little thyme}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "Moisten with {{ing_07|broth}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "Roast in the oven."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "And all over sprinkle {{ing_08|1/2 ounce of pepper}}, {{ing_03|rue}}, {{ing_05|onions}}, {{ing_04|satury}}, {{ing_09|4 dates}}, and {{ing_10|raisins}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "The gravy is given plenty of color over the open fire, and is seasoned with {{ing_11|wine}}, {{ing_12|oil}}, {{ing_07|broth}}, {{ing_13|reduced wine}}, frequently stirring it (basting the {{ing_01|hare}}) so that it may absorb all the flavor."
    },
    {
      "step": 8,
      "text": "After that, serve it in a round dish with dry {{ing_02|pepper}}."
    }
